hero.title: Every stage of your web project, covered
hero.body: Four core service areas, from clear requirements to launch, ongoing improvements and paid traffic. Choose one or combine them around your project.

webDevelopment.title: Web Development
webDevelopment.body: Turn your designs and requirements into a website with the structure, features and integrations your business needs.

features.title: Design implementation
features.text: Build website pages from your approved design.

features.title: Content management
features.text: Set up tools for your team to edit and publish content.

features.title: Responsive behavior
features.text: Adapt layouts and interactions for desktop, tablet and mobile.

features.title: Structure & navigation
features.text: Organize pages, content and user journeys before development.

features.title: Integrations
features.text: Connect forms, external tools and business systems.

features.title: Testing & launch
features.text: Check agreed features and prepare the website to go live.

get.title: A responsive website, ready to launch
get.text: Your approved design brought to life: featuring editable content and the integrations essential for your business.

aiBuild.title: AI Build
aiBuild.body: One connected workflow from a Figma design to a live, editable website. We set up the site, an admin panel and a Telegram bot on a single shared database, so your team can update content without touching code.

websiteSupport.title: Website Support & Development
websiteSupport.body: New pages, functionality and integrations for a site that is already live, delivered in agreed releases.

features.title: New pages
features.text: Extend your website with new pages and landing pages.

features.title: Functionality
features.text: Add or refine features on your existing website.

features.title: Integrations
features.text: Connect your website to external tools and business systems.

features.title: Ongoing support
features.text: Maintain and improve your website at an agreed pace.

features.title: Release cycle
features.text: Group changes into planned releases with a clear scope for each one.

features.title: Taking over an existing site
features.text: Pick up a project built by another team, with access and hosting set in order.

get.title: Website improvements, delivered in planned releases
get.text: New pages, features and integrations - tested and delivered in agreed releases.

businessAnalysis.title: Business Analysis
businessAnalysis.body: Understand your processes, clarify business needs and turn them into clear requirements for implementation.

features.title: Analyze the process and identify bottlenecks
features.text: Map steps and roles to uncover delays, data issues and duplicated work.

features.title: Define the target process
features.text: Describe how the process should run once the change is in place.

features.title: Prepare requirements for automation
features.text: Turn the target process into clear requirements for implementation.

features.title: Clarify the business need
features.text: Define what the software needs to achieve and who it should serve.

features.title: Document system and integration requirements
features.text: Organize requirements by function, priority and dependency, including data exchange with existing systems.

features.title: Align business and implementation teams
features.text: Keep both sides aligned on scope, decisions and changes throughout implementation.

get.title: Clear requirements for confident implementation
get.text: Documented processes, prioritized requirements and agreed scope — so your team knows what to build, why it matters and how to verify the result.

googleAds.title: Google Ads
googleAds.body: Set up and manage campaigns to reach people searching for your products or services.

features.title: Campaign setup
features.text: Prepare and launch campaigns around your goals.

features.title: Campaign management
features.text: Monitor performance and refine ongoing campaigns.

features.title: Audience targeting
features.text: Focus your campaigns on relevant searches and audiences.

features.title: Tracking & reporting
features.text: Set up conversion tracking and report on what the budget returns.

cta.title: Tell us what needs to be built, and what already exists
cta.body: ONVORX will review the requirements and clarify what's needed to prepare a project estimate.
